query:
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage, notes)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 
  CASE 
    WHEN m.name = '1,8-Cineole' THEN 35.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Alpha-terpinyl acetate' THEN 30.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Linalool' THEN 5.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Limonene' THEN 8.0
  END,
  CASE 
    WHEN m.name = '1,8-Cineole' THEN 'Composant majeur, note fraîche eucalyptée'
    WHEN m.name = 'Alpha-terpinyl acetate' THEN 'Note épicée caractéristique'
    WHEN m.name = 'Linalool' THEN 'Note florale légère'
    WHEN m.name = 'Limonene' THEN 'Note citronnée'
  END
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name = 'Cardamome' 
AND m.name IN ('1,8-Cineole', 'Alpha-terpinyl acetate', 'Linalool', 'Limonene');
